title: JavaRailways display templates v1
description: XML template declarations for captured train-package resources or independent Decorations style bundles. External bundle IDs require the directory-name prefix followed by a dot, and external bundles cannot declare category defaults. Filesystem containment/existence and reference resolution are validated by the loader.

file.description: Resource-directory-relative POSIX XML path with no empty, dot or parent segments. Loader also enforces safe containment and readable file existence.
